notes.title: Aeolis Tournament is Available Now! (15% off)
notes.content:
It's finally here! 

Aeolis Tournament is now available on Steam! (with a 15% discount for the whole week!) 

Gather your friends and blast them off the competition. Buy Aeolis Tournament today!

After 2 years of hard work, we're very happy that our little baby is finally out there. It's our first game as a studio and won't be the last.
For this reason, we would like to get your feedback! Don't hesitate to leave us a review, ask your questions in the community forums or chat with us on our Discord!

Thanks to everyone who have supported us through our journey! ♥

Have a great week!

notes.title: 24h Before Launch!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Only 24h left before we released Aeolis Tournament to the world!! 

We're sooooo excited! It has been 2 great years full of challenges, learning and fun! However, we never knew that learning to build a company while developing the game would be so challenging. We never would have imagined that we would be launching the game when the world is in such a mess. But, we rose up to the challenge. We are glad to finally show you all the work we've done! We are a small team of pretty creative and positive people whose only goal is to create fun experiences to share with your family and friends. It has been our dream since we were little to make our own games and share it with people. We've finally made it, it has been a fun ride! Now, we hope you'll have as much fun playing as we had developing it. Don't forget to grab your discount starting tomorrow!

See you then!

https://media.giphy.com/media/b1o4elYH8Tqjm/giphy.gif

notes.title: Aeolis Tournament AMA Schedule on Discord
notes.content:
Hey there! If you want to discuss with the Beyond Fun Studio's developers about Aeolis Tournament, you can do so easily by going to Aeolis Tournament Discord Server! (the chat will be in the #ask-the-devs Channel) 
Here's the schedule:

Tuesday June 16th
We will do an "Ask Me Anything" event on Aeolis Tournament Discord with the team to discuss the game and its features. Feel free to come by from 3 to 4PM EST and ask us anything!

Wednesday June 17th
We will host another AMA event on the discord to talk about the studio and the team behind the game. Come ask your questions from 1 to 2PM EST, on Discord.

Saturday June 20th
This will be our last official AMA for the Steam Game Festival: Summer Edition. Ask us anything we might not have covered from 1 to 2PM EST!

notes.title: Guerrilla Collective
notes.content:
LIVE at 9am PST @ https://www.twitch.tv/GuerrillaCollective



Great news!

We're proud to announce that Aeolis Tournament will be a part of the Guerrilla Collective online event! With all the festivals like E3 being canceled with nothing to replace it in the future, we had to adapt quickly and change how we were going to show the game before its release. We were fortunate enough to be chosen to participate in this new game festival.

[previewyoutube=5RY7sfAqnDs;full][/previewyoutube]

The events will take place from June 13-15, with a bunch of amazing games to discover.
BUT, tune in on June 14 at 9 am Pacific | 6 pm Central Europe for a BIG announcement concerning Aeolis Tournament! We hope you'll love it!

Stay tuned! 

Learn more about the event here: https://www.guerrillacollective.com/

notes.title: Come play Aeolis Tournament at PAX East in the Indie MEGABOOTH section
notes.content:
We've been selected to be a part of the Indie Megabooth

PAX East will take place in Boston, MA from Feb 27 to Mar 1. You'll be able to find us at booth #24046 with a bunch of other awesome indie games in the Indie Megabooth section.

We're pretty excited and proud to be a part of this event. Our trip to PAX South was a success, with constant traffic of players wanting to try the tournament with their friends. We can't wait to see what it's going to be like in the Indie Megabooth section. 

Come hangout at our booth if you want to talk with the team, the whole trio is going to be there this time! We're going to hold a few tournaments for those interested in friendly competitions and we have a few surprises to show so be sure to come by! 

We can't wait to see you there!

48h to go on the Kickstarter
If you're interested in supporting the development or want to have an early access to the game, be sure to check out our kickstarter. It's ending soon!

notes.title: Take a sneak peek of Aeolis Tournament at PAX South
notes.content:
Happy new year everyone! 

We hope you had a wonderful time with your family and friends during the holidays.

We had a well deserved break, but now we start 2020 with full force with an announcement:

We're attending PAX South!

Pax South will take place in San Antonio, TX from January 17 to 19. Drop by and test the crazy new content we added in Aeolis Tournament!

We'll see you there!

- Beyond Fun Studio
